actions.action: Repot into a larger pot (3-5 inches wider and deeper) with drainage or a self-watering planter
Prune and trim leaves, edges and tips
Add support stakes to straighten the leaning plant
Place plant close to a bright natural light source
Keep a fan on or windows open for air circulation when the AC is off
Mist the plant daily or run a humidifier nearby
Wipe dust off leaves with a moist paper towel every 2-3 weeks
Top up the soil when the level gets low
Test soil moisture with a moisture meter every 7-10 days
Water slowly in two halves using the half-pot-volume method and empty the saucer

verdict.reason: The answer identifies the plant as having outgrown its pot (root-bound) and its main advice is to repot into a bigger pot, matching the fix the poster followed; it recommends only 3-5 inches larger and warns against oversized pots, so nothing in it is harmful.
